# THM commands

<!-- ANCHOR: commands -->

## `xrf-cli thm bump-alignment`

Report whether each texture's bump belongs to its diffuse, by how closely the bump's slopes follow the diffuse's edges

```txt
xrf-cli thm bump-alignment [OPTIONS] <path>...
```

| Option              | Required | Default                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<path>`            | yes      |                           | Root holding the textures and their descriptors. Give several to layer them, highest priority first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--source <source>` |          | `containing-installation` | How to read the path: auto treats it as an installation only when it declares one, directory ignores any declaration, volumes mounts every archive volume beneath it, installation requires one, containing-installation searches parent directories for one. Possible values: `auto`, `directory`, `volumes`, `installation`, `containing-installation`. |
| `--prefix <prefix>` |          |                           | Limit to the descriptors of one logical subtree, such as textures\wpn                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `-s, --silent`      |          |                           | Turn off logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `-v, --verbose`     |          |                           | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--json`            |          |                           | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--report <PATH>`   |          |                           | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## `xrf-cli thm info`

Print what a THM file holds, every field of a texture descriptor by the SDK's own names

```txt
xrf-cli thm info [OPTIONS] <path>
```

| Option            | Required | Default | Description                                                          |
| ----------------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<path>`          | yes      |         | Path to thm file                                                     |
| `-s, --silent`    |          |         | Turn off logging                                                     |
| `-v, --verbose`   |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                              |
| `--json`          |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr |
| `--report <PATH>` |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                |

## `xrf-cli thm patch-bump`

Repoint the bump texture reference of a THM file

```txt
xrf-cli thm patch-bump [OPTIONS] <--to <to>|--off> <path>
```

| Option              | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                    |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<path>`            | yes      |         | Path to thm file                                                                                               |
| `-d, --dest <dest>` |          |         | Path to resulting thm file, defaults to in place rewrite of the source file                                    |
| `--to <to>`         |          |         | Bump texture reference to write, engine style without extension, for example 'wpn\wpn_pm\wpn_pm_bump'          |
| `--off`             |          |         | Declare no bump at all, clearing the mode and the name; use for a bump that does not exist and is not going to |
| `--dry-run`         |          |         | Validate the change and report the result without writing any file                                             |
| `-s, --silent`      |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                               |
| `-v, --verbose`     |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                        |
| `--json`            |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                           |
| `--report <PATH>`   |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                          |

## `xrf-cli thm set-field`

Set named fields on texture descriptors in place, every other byte of each left as it was; a directory sets them on
every texture descriptor below it

```txt
xrf-cli thm set-field [OPTIONS] <--texture-type <texture-type>|--format <format>|--mip-filter <mip-filter>|--bump-mode <bump-mode>|--bump-name <bump-name>|--detail-name <detail-name>|--detail-scale <detail-scale>|--material <material>|--material-weight <material-weight>|--border-color <border-color>|--fade-color <fade-color>|--fade-amount <fade-amount>|--fade-delay <fade-delay>|--ext-normal-map <ext-normal-map>|--virtual-height <virtual-height>|--set-flag <set-flag>|--clear-flag <clear-flag>> <path>
```

| Option                                | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<path>`                              | yes      |         | Path to a thm file, or to a directory whose texture descriptors are all edited                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--dry-run`                           |          |         | Report which descriptors would change without writing any                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--texture-type <texture-type>`       |          |         | Texture type, the gate the engine reads first. Possible values: `image`, `cube-map`, `bump-map`, `normal-map`, `terrain`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--format <format>`                   |          |         | Format the converter builds the texture in. Possible values: `dxt1`, `dxt1-alpha`, `dxt3`, `dxt5`, `rgba4444`, `rgba1555`, `rgb565`, `rgb`, `rgba`, `nvhs`, `nvhu`, `a8`, `l8`, `a8l8`.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--mip-filter <mip-filter>`           |          |         | Filter the converter reduces each mip level with; 'advanced' selects the SDK's own chain. Possible values: `advanced`, `point`, `box`, `triangle`, `quadratic`, `cubic`, `catrom`, `mitchell`, `gaussian`, `sinc`, `bessel`, `hanning`, `hamming`, `blackman`, `kaiser`.                                                                            |
| `--bump-mode <bump-mode>`             |          |         | Whether the renderer binds the bump pair. Possible values: `none`, `use`, `use-parallax`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--bump-name <bump-name>`             |          |         | Bump texture, engine style without extension, for example 'wpn\wpn_pm\wpn_pm_bump'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--detail-name <detail-name>`         |          |         | Detail texture, engine style without extension; empty for none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--detail-scale <detail-scale>`       |          |         | How many times the detail texture repeats over the texture                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--material <material>`               |          |         | Shading pair the renderer blends between. Possible values: `oren-nayar-blin`, `blin-phong`, `phong-metal`, `metal-oren-nayar`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--material-weight <material-weight>` |          |         | Where between the two shadings the texture sits                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `--border-color <border-color>`       |          |         | Border colour, AARRGGBB in hex                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--fade-color <fade-color>`           |          |         | Colour the mip chain fades towards, AARRGGBB in hex; its alpha is the alpha fade's target                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--fade-amount <fade-amount>`         |          |         | Percent of the way each faded mip level moves towards the fade colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `--fade-delay <fade-delay>`           |          |         | First mip level the fade reaches                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--ext-normal-map <ext-normal-map>`   |          |         | Normal map the bump generator takes instead of deriving one, engine style; empty for none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--virtual-height <virtual-height>`   |          |         | Relief height the bump generator reads, and nothing at runtime                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--set-flag <set-flag>...`            |          |         | Flag to set, by its SDK name; repeat or separate with commas. Possible values: `flGenerateMipMaps`, `flBinaryAlpha`, `flAlphaBorder`, `flColorBorder`, `flFadeToColor`, `flFadeToAlpha`, `flDitherColor`, `flDitherEachMIPLevel`, `flDiffuseDetail`, `flImplicitLighted`, `flHasAlpha`, `flBumpDetail`. Accepts multiple values separated by `,`.   |
| `--clear-flag <clear-flag>...`        |          |         | Flag to clear, by its SDK name; repeat or separate with commas. Possible values: `flGenerateMipMaps`, `flBinaryAlpha`, `flAlphaBorder`, `flColorBorder`, `flFadeToColor`, `flFadeToAlpha`, `flDitherColor`, `flDitherEachMIPLevel`, `flDiffuseDetail`, `flImplicitLighted`, `flHasAlpha`, `flBumpDetail`. Accepts multiple values separated by `,`. |
| `-s, --silent`                        |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `-v, --verbose`                       |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--json`                              |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--report <PATH>`                     |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

## `xrf-cli thm write`

Write a complete texture descriptor for a DDS file, at the SDK's new-file defaults with the size and format the file
states, then the fields named

```txt
xrf-cli thm write [OPTIONS] <path>
```

| Option                                | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<path>`                              | yes      |         | Path to the dds file to write a descriptor for                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `-d, --dest <dest>`                   |          |         | Path of the thm file to write, defaults to the one beside the dds file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `-f, --force`                         |          |         | Replace the thm file where it already exists; without it, one there is refused before reading                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--dry-run`                           |          |         | Report the descriptor without writing it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--texture-type <texture-type>`       |          |         | Texture type, the gate the engine reads first. Possible values: `image`, `cube-map`, `bump-map`, `normal-map`, `terrain`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--format <format>`                   |          |         | Format the converter builds the texture in. Possible values: `dxt1`, `dxt1-alpha`, `dxt3`, `dxt5`, `rgba4444`, `rgba1555`, `rgb565`, `rgb`, `rgba`, `nvhs`, `nvhu`, `a8`, `l8`, `a8l8`.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--mip-filter <mip-filter>`           |          |         | Filter the converter reduces each mip level with; 'advanced' selects the SDK's own chain. Possible values: `advanced`, `point`, `box`, `triangle`, `quadratic`, `cubic`, `catrom`, `mitchell`, `gaussian`, `sinc`, `bessel`, `hanning`, `hamming`, `blackman`, `kaiser`.                                                                            |
| `--bump-mode <bump-mode>`             |          |         | Whether the renderer binds the bump pair. Possible values: `none`, `use`, `use-parallax`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--bump-name <bump-name>`             |          |         | Bump texture, engine style without extension, for example 'wpn\wpn_pm\wpn_pm_bump'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--detail-name <detail-name>`         |          |         | Detail texture, engine style without extension; empty for none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--detail-scale <detail-scale>`       |          |         | How many times the detail texture repeats over the texture                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--material <material>`               |          |         | Shading pair the renderer blends between. Possible values: `oren-nayar-blin`, `blin-phong`, `phong-metal`, `metal-oren-nayar`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--material-weight <material-weight>` |          |         | Where between the two shadings the texture sits                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `--border-color <border-color>`       |          |         | Border colour, AARRGGBB in hex                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--fade-color <fade-color>`           |          |         | Colour the mip chain fades towards, AARRGGBB in hex; its alpha is the alpha fade's target                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--fade-amount <fade-amount>`         |          |         | Percent of the way each faded mip level moves towards the fade colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `--fade-delay <fade-delay>`           |          |         | First mip level the fade reaches                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--ext-normal-map <ext-normal-map>`   |          |         | Normal map the bump generator takes instead of deriving one, engine style; empty for none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--virtual-height <virtual-height>`   |          |         | Relief height the bump generator reads, and nothing at runtime                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--set-flag <set-flag>...`            |          |         | Flag to set, by its SDK name; repeat or separate with commas. Possible values: `flGenerateMipMaps`, `flBinaryAlpha`, `flAlphaBorder`, `flColorBorder`, `flFadeToColor`, `flFadeToAlpha`, `flDitherColor`, `flDitherEachMIPLevel`, `flDiffuseDetail`, `flImplicitLighted`, `flHasAlpha`, `flBumpDetail`. Accepts multiple values separated by `,`.   |
| `--clear-flag <clear-flag>...`        |          |         | Flag to clear, by its SDK name; repeat or separate with commas. Possible values: `flGenerateMipMaps`, `flBinaryAlpha`, `flAlphaBorder`, `flColorBorder`, `flFadeToColor`, `flFadeToAlpha`, `flDitherColor`, `flDitherEachMIPLevel`, `flDiffuseDetail`, `flImplicitLighted`, `flHasAlpha`, `flBumpDetail`. Accepts multiple values separated by `,`. |
| `-s, --silent`                        |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `-v, --verbose`                       |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--json`                              |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--report <PATH>`                     |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
